article_summary: The article describes a photoredox/HAT dual-catalyzed carboxylation of benzyl chlorides using CO2. The system utilizes an iridium photocatalyst, sodium thiophenolate (PhSNa) as a catalytic HAT reagent, and potassium formate (HCO2K) as a green reductant. The reaction proceeds via the in situ generation of the CO2 radical anion, which facilitates C-Cl bond cleavage to form benzyl radicals and subsequently benzyl carbanions for nucleophilic attack on CO2.
